description: Store a compaction summary from context management. Called when conversation history is compacted to preserve key information as a long-term memory. Not typically user-invoked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Confirmation that compaction summary was stored as a memory
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Storing a context compaction summary as a long-term memory
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: EmbeddingError: failed to generate embedding for summary. DatabaseError: failed to persist memory to storage.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For embedding errors: verify embedding service is available. For database errors: verify state and vector storage are accessible.
